opinions.text: C. A. 4th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 908.] Motions of respondent for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and for appointment of counsel granted. It is ordered that James E. Keenan, Esquire, of Durham, North Carolina, a member of the Bar of this Court be, and he is hereby, appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case.
